text:
agent2 (tax) proposed API, please object or confirm:
1) tax.py exposes: sales_tax_cents(region, lines, discount_pct=0) -> int (cents).
   - region: customer's region code string (e.g. 'TX'), or None if the customer is unknown -> tax 0.
   - lines: iterable of (category: str, amount_cents: int) for each order line (line total in cents, after quantity).
   - discount_pct: customer's discount percent (e.g. 10 for 10%), default 0.
   - Unknown region string (not in rates.csv) -> KeyError. Exempt categories (currently 'food') are excluded from the base.
2) Helpers: tax_rate_pct(region) -> float (KeyError if unknown), is_exempt(category) -> bool.
Requests: agent1 (pricing) - please give each order line its item's category, and give invoice the customer's region (None if unknown) and discount_pct. agent3 (invoice) - call tax.sales_tax_cents(...) and do not compute tax yourself. Rounding: exact Decimal math, one round-half-up to the cent at the end.

agent3 (invoice) API proposal. Reply accept/object or counter-propose. All money = Decimal dollars; percents = multipliers; lookups that find nothing return the default.

pricing.py (agent1):
  has_sku(sku) -> bool
  unit_price(sku) -> Decimal, Decimal('0') if unknown sku
  customer_name(customer_id) -> str, '' if unknown customer (I then show the id)
  discount_multiplier(customer_id) -> Decimal, e.g. Decimal('0.90') for 10% off; Decimal('1') for no discount or unknown customer (exception to the 0 default: 0 would mean 100% off)

tax.py (agent2):
  compute_tax(customer_id, lines, discount) -> (tax_amount: Decimal rounded to cent, tax_multiplier: Decimal, e.g. Decimal('1.0825'); Decimal('1') if no tax / unknown customer)
    lines = list of (sku, line_amount Decimal) for KNOWN skus only, in order (so per-item taxability can be decided by tax.py)
    discount = Decimal dollar amount already computed by invoice.py (positive)
  Reason: the example total (Tax 8.25% = $1.86) does not equal 8.25% of the 35.19 taxable subtotal, so tax must depend on per-line info that only tax.py knows. Please confirm the example values with your rules.

invoice.py (me): computes subtotal, discount = round_half_up(subtotal * (1 - discount_multiplier)), total = subtotal - discount + tax; displays percents as (multiplier-1)*100 without trailing zeros.

agent1: pricing.py is implemented (file: pricing.py, data loaded from data_pricing/). API: get_item(sku) -> {sku,name,price,category} or None; get_price(sku) -> float dollars or None; get_customer(customer_id) -> {id,name,discount,region} or None, where discount is a fraction (0.10 = 10%); list_items(); list_customers(). Money is float dollars, percents are fractions, misses return None. I have proposed this as PRICING_API in the agreement log. Please respond there if you need changes. Note: tax.py should take the customer's region from get_customer(...)['region'] and tax rules belong to agent2.

[agent3] Confirm: I accept agent2's tax API as-is (tax.sales_tax_cents(region, lines, discount_pct), tax.tax_rate_pct(region), tax.is_exempt). It is more concrete than mine, so I drop my compute_tax proposal. invoice.py will: convert Decimal dollars to int cents at the boundary, pass lines as (category, cents) for known skus only, pass discount_pct as a percent number, and round the discount to the cent myself (half up) so the displayed discount and total match. For unknown customer (region None) I show 0% tax and do not call tax_rate_pct.
Requests for agent1 (pricing), please provide exactly:
  pricing.has_sku(sku) -> bool
  pricing.unit_price_cents(sku) -> int (0 if unknown)   [or unit price in cents; I will format]
  pricing.item_category(sku) -> str ('' if unknown)
  pricing.customer_name(customer_id) -> str ('' if unknown; I then show the id)
  pricing.customer_region(customer_id) -> str or None (None if unknown)
  pricing.customer_discount_pct(customer_id) -> number, percent e.g. 10 (0 if none/unknown)
agent1: if your names differ, tell me and I will adapt. Please reply accept/object.

[agent3] invoice.py is done. It uses agent1's API as posted (pricing.get_item(sku) -> {price,category} or None; pricing.get_customer(cid) -> {name,discount fraction,region} or None) and agent2's API (tax.sales_tax_cents(region, [(category, cents)], discount_pct) and tax.tax_rate_pct(region)). Money is int cents at the tax boundary. Unknown customer: name = id, no tax call, 0%. I tested with stub modules outside the repo: the sample order prints exactly the expected 8 lines (tax stubbed to 186 cents). Note for agent2: the sample Tax (8.25%) = $1.86 does not equal 8.25% of the taxable subtotal ($35.19 -> $2.90), so please check your exemption/base rules against that sample. Ideally agent1 and agent2 confirm the function names exist exactly as listed.
